title: Eastern Flank Monitor
partial: This week is partial. It is shown. It does not decide the test.
nodata_layer: {layer} has no data, which is not calm.
def_0: All layers at or near normal.
def_1: One layer elevated, or several slightly above normal.
def_2: Two layers elevated at the same time.
def_3: Three layers elevated, or Capability and Intent both strongly elevated. Analyst-confirmed.
def_4: Capability and Intent both at high levels, plus at least one other layer elevated. Analyst-confirmed.
explain_intent: Stored Intent level for this week. It is not a new score.
explain_capability_empty: No active posture event. That is no data, not calm.
explain_opportunity: Force availability is {o1}. US commitment is {o2}.
explain_opportunity_one: {name} is {value}. The other indicator has no data.
explain_opportunity_empty: No force-availability or commitment reading. That is no data, not calm.
explain_hybrid: No data. A missing layer is not calm.
intent_source: Intent comes from the stored GDELT sample. This page does not recompute it.
preparedness_other: For Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, and Poland, follow your national authorities. This app does not write its own crisis instructions.
events_none: No posture event has been reached yet.
disclaimer_short: Independent analysis project. Not an official warning service. In a crisis, follow your national authorities.
disclaimer_full: This app is an independent, non-commercial analysis project based on publicly available information. It is not affiliated with any government, military or official agency, and it is not an official warning or alert service. Its assessments may be incomplete or wrong. Do not base safety decisions on this app alone. In any emergency or crisis, follow the instructions of your national authorities and official emergency services.
explainer_weather: The app is a weather station. It reads public instruments and shows the picture. It is not the weather service, and it is not a siren. It does not issue an official warning, and it does not tell you what to do. In a crisis, follow your national authorities.
explainer_smoke: A smoke detector should sound for a fire. It should not sound every time someone burns toast. Test A, Ukraine, asks whether the method rises before 24 February 2022. That is the fire check. Test B, the eastern flank, asks whether tension in that window is treated as a war. A bump is burnt toast. A war-level alarm there, with no war in those five countries, is the detector failing that check. The stored results are not changed by this comparison.
explainer_witnesses: One witness is not enough to raise the town alarm. The overall level stays at Watchful until two layers are elevated at the same time. An empty layer is not a second witness. It is also not zero.
explainer_temperature: A temperature is read against what is normal, not against zero. The registered normal is the median of the calibration weeks. The scale is the median absolute deviation times 1.4826. A high week is high relative to that reference. The cutoffs were set before the scoring run. They are not a fever chart drawn after the fact.
explainer_poll: I2 does not read every headline. Each week it reads a fixed sample, the way a poll reads a sample of people. The share is an estimate, with a confidence interval. Someone who did not answer is left out. They are not counted as a no, and they are not counted as calm.
explainer_referee: The classifier makes the first call. A second model can look again at a flagged sample, the way a referee's call can be checked on replay. The replay does not rewrite the rules. Where a human label exists, that written call stands.
explainer_envelope: The cutoffs and the baseline method were written down and tagged before the real-data scoring run. That is a sealed envelope. You do not open it after the result and change the rules to fit the score. A later change is a new envelope, and it is reported on its own. The first run's levels stay as stored.
explainer_phone: A phone that does not ring may have nothing to say, or it may be off because the battery is dead. Silence is not the same as calm. A missing day, a missing source date, or an answer marked AI unavailable is no data. It is not zero, and it is not Calm.
